coverage_exempt.reason: Original registry growth 0x4db6e0 puts failed realloc result zero in EBP (0x4db70b or 0x4db77f), then calls 0x4dc680 at 0x4db788; that helper reads [EBP+4] and faults before growth can return zero. This caller failure continuation is unreachable with valid backed memory. Original failure evidence: work/packets/level_one_enemy_actions/cases-run-2.log.

Successful first lookup either already contains the index or grows the registry bounds to contain it. Between the two bound checks there is only a slot read and scratch reset, no callback or mutation of bounds. The second out-of-range growth branch is unreachable for a valid registry; physical allocator fixtures must not mutate game registry fields.

Second-growth failure continuation is unreachable: successful first lookup establishes enclosing bounds without an intervening callback; additionally allocation failure in original 0x4db6e0 faults through null EBP in 0x4dc680 before returning zero.
Earlier bit-three test requires receiver+0x2fc > 3 to reach this bit-two check. No intervening call or store changes the count, so the count <= 2 branch cannot execute.
